name: wordpress-security-hardening
description: WordPress hardening as must-use plugins and a live header check, with every verdict, every hook and every declared limit driven by a test suite that needs no WordPress install, no database and no network.

scripts.test: node --test test/catalogue.test.mjs test/collect-decide.test.mjs test/fixtures.test.mjs test/headers-plugin.test.mjs test/ip-range.test.mjs test/judge.test.mjs test/limits.test.mjs test/login-plugin.test.mjs test/normalize.test.mjs test/pairs.test.mjs test/php-pairs.test.mjs test/tools.test.mjs test/tracked.test.mjs test/xmlrpc-plugin.test.mjs
scripts.lint:php: find mu-plugins lib examples -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
scripts.lint:sh: bash -n scripts/check-headers.sh && bash -n scripts/collect-decide.sh && bash -n scripts/judge-headers.sh
scripts.check: npm run lint:php && npm run lint:sh
